hooks.name: PII and secret guard
hooks.description: Block tool input containing secrets or Singapore personal data (PDPA; MAS TRM 11.1)

hooks.name: Git history guard
hooks.description: Block force-push, pushes to main/master and history rewrites (MAS TRM 6.3, 7.5)

hooks.name: Destructive filesystem guard
hooks.description: Block recursive deletion of protected paths, .git removal and raw device writes (MAS TRM 11.3)

hooks.name: Audit logger
hooks.description: Append a hash-chained JSONL record per tool call (MAS TRM 12.2; supplementary to Kiro prompt logging)
